passes.notes: Pass 1 [0,3500): packet schema v1, checked 2026-10-11, preserves 40-item base. Opening RCA 630TS is a museum specimen manufactured 1946–48 (order by start), US tabletop KCS20A; distinguish cabinet/body-kit sales, not global launch. Workflow depends on broadcast signal and specific 115V/60Hz specimen plate, warm-up 15–20 seconds from manual, and separate controls; no service/high-voltage handling inferred. Importance is household viewing arrangement, not unsupported invention-first claim. [3500,7000): RCA facts map specimen supply voltage/form variants to I150-S011/S012; related-model proposals and chronicle placement are curatorial metadata, not extra proof. Second entry Sony TV8-301 is May 1960 Japanese original, explicitly not TV5-303; 23 transistors/19 diodes and eight-inch CRT, multiple power sources; different supply options have conditions and portability should not imply signal or arbitrary car compatibility. [7000,10500): TV8-301 event/variant and component values are tied to I150-S013/S014, without elevating design launch into proof of universal use. Third model Sony KV-1310 (1968) is early Trinitron color TV, 13-inch, 3-in-1 electron gun with aperture grille, not thin CRT successor; history’s two-times-brightness figure explicitly remains vendor comparative claim. [10500,14000): KV-1310 exact Japanese model excludes UK KV-1330UB; dates map I150-S015, core grille/gun structure I150-S013. Source scope avoids attributing an award to one model. Sharp AQUOS C1 begins as Jan 1, 2001 series rollout but this entry is 20-inch LC20C1; handle, stand and thin LCD are the movable-display story, with accessory/support constraints. [14000,17500): LC20C1 records Japanese 20-inch Jan 1 launch and distinguishes 13-inch delayed release; brightness 450 cd/m² is manufacturer listed, not measured. The wrap-up explicitly does not project later wireless/network or battery features; specs/room conditions are separated. Samsung The Frame begins as UK 55-inch LS003 2017 item, Germany reprint only for model/operation; no cross-region tuner blending. [17500,21000): The Frame LS003 is 2017 UK availability, Europe 55-inch; later anti-reflection/processor/gallery packages excluded. Art Mode is emissive and consumes power, application/photo compatibility not assumed current; sensor automation is assistive, not guaranteed. Sources map availability to I150-S058 and operation/model to S059. Next Sero starts as 2020 model. [21000,24500): Sero LS05T is 2020 France-available European 43-inch, with Austria suffix only tied to that region; rotate screen to align vertical phone video, but the installation must reserve full movement clearance. Device/voice/network compatibility and 4K-source distinctions are explicit. [24500,28000): LG RX Korean first-shop actual sale 2020-10-20, distinct from show debut; Korea 65-inch identity while Poland RX9LA lends common structure only. Three modes have specific use rather than arbitrary-height proposition; base remains a large device. Korea/Poland sources separated to avoid region, service and tuner transfer. [28000,31500): source catalog distinguishes independent museum record (RCA specimen) from manual mirror excerpts (operating paragraph only, PDF unreadable/cache miss); Sony maker archive supports listed model dates/structure, not experience. Sharp design database and LG Europe model page provide narrowly scoped form factors, not current wireless capability or Korea services. [31500,35000): Sony milestone/corporate sources are first-party and explicitly disallow recasting team award as KV-1310 award. Sharp sources distinguish 20C1 Jan launch from delayed 13C1; listed brightness is manufacturer metric. Samsung UK availability announcement anchors LS003 UK timing; its model brochure is an editorial reprint hosted by Samsung, not independent hands-on review. [35000,38526): Sero and RX source entries distinguish French/Austrian/Polish/Korean regional evidence, use manufacturer archives only for scoped model/availability and not independent experience; Samsung’s hosted editorial reprint has unknown sample/reprint terms. The closing import instructions keep scope fixed, IDs with coordinator, defer links and retain media fallback. Validation flags are packet claims, not external verification. Framework image is a 2022-01 exhibit, before the May 2022 12th-gen announcement; image supports modular chassis/parts but not processor/storage. Nokia 3310 photo from 2017 shows original body, not cited O2 unit or 2017 reboot. Osborne 1 opens showing display/drives/keyboard; PSVR photo is 2016 first-gen pre-ZVR2. TR-808/TB-303/DX7 panels support visible controls only; DX7 is author-composited and attribution is retained.

Pass 2 [0,3500): RCA usage relies only on indexed manual p.5 operation paragraph; PDF text/screenshot inaccessible and not described as fully read. Voltage applies only the museum specimen; warm-up is manual guidance, not today’s machine guarantee. The viewing controls must not be confused with internal high-voltage service work; missing broadcast signal cannot be fixed by knobs. Manufacturing range and set/cabinet variants are separate evidence from manual. [3500,7000): RCA source IDs separate museum object fields from the operational manual; line-level fact citations are preserved. Sony TV8-301 is listed as Japanese original, May 1960 and not TV5-303. Three power inputs are model-specific and require appropriate preparation; indoor/outdoor/car scenarios in vendor history do not establish arbitrary vehicle power compatibility or guaranteed reception. Eight-inch CRT remains an actual thickness/distance constraint. [7000,10500): TV8-301 facts are limited to the Japanese model and its listed circuits/power choices, with no claim of actual broad portability outcomes. KV-1310 is 1968 Japan original, not UK KV-1330UB; the Trinitron structure and 13-inch size are model-specific. Brightness multiplier is maker promotional comparison, not an independent controlled measurement. [10500,14000): KV-1310 significance does not mistake later team honors for this model’s award; present service and surviving specimen conditions are left open. Sharp AQUOS entry is confined to 20-inch LC20C1, while other size’s delayed release is kept separate. Stand/handle placement is not equivalent to built-in wireless or bundled optional mount; product metric remains attributed, not independently tested. [14000,17500): LC20C1 does not inherit later tuner/battery/network functions; dimensions with and without stand are distinct, and 450 cd/m² remains an untested maker figure. Shared maker source provenance is called out so archive confirmation is not presented as consumer consensus. The Frame dated UK availability and Germany reprint sources are assigned different evidentiary roles. [17500,21000): LS003 Art Mode can be treated as electrical display, not off state; current gallery/app support unproven. SmartView, USB and sensor descriptions are from hosted magazine reprint, which has unknown sample/reprint terms and is not a manufacturer manual or independent retest. Frame is European 55-inch 2017 edition; later LS03 and regional tuner variants excluded. [21000,24500): Sero’s France announcement and Austria model entry are used in separate roles; rotation controls do not imply arbitrary placement or universal Tap View/Bixby compatibility. 4K panel is distinguished from source-video resolution, and stand clearance is a real installation constraint. [24500,28000): RX Korean launch is actual first-shop sale 2020-10-20, not fair demo; Polish RX9LA lends only shared structure and not Korean tuner/services. Screen rolls into base, so room clearance, power and base remain; lifetime not inferred from product page. Three view modes have discrete intended tasks, not arbitrary crop states. [28000,31500): CWI sources are narrow archive excerpts, with manual PDF inaccessible for RCA and LG only sharing a subset of model structure; museum object and maker source have distinct evidentiary role. No source record conveys media rights or independent experience; this prevents silently treating sources as interchangeable. [31500,35000): Sony is maker archive without independent cross-check; team-level recognition deliberately not assigned to KV-1310. Sharp maker record distinguishes 20-inch and 13-inch launch dates; Samsung UK record supports sale only, while brochure is editorial content hosted by maker with sample/reprint conditions unverified. [35000,38526): Sero/RX records remain maker-first scoped, not independent review; Korean sale record is archived page excerpt, Europe/Poland provides model structure only. The import footer keeps selected-list size, coordinator ID assignment, chronicle/category freeze and deferred-link controls. The validation object is carried as packet metadata, not an external audit.

passes.notes: Pass 3 [0,3500): RCA prose uses a conditional, stepwise viewing scenario and limits comparison to room/furniture arrangement; “not firstness” and “not a license to service high voltage” are important historical/safety qualifications. The practical point is that controls remain plural and signal-dependent, not anachronistic one-button UX. It preserves the split between a museum artifact’s manufacturing range and product release. [3500,7000): RCA related links frame its relationship to radio and later portable television as interpretive comparison; no claim that they share circuitry. TV8-301 narrative makes portability a task choice, not an endpoint or universal market transformation; small CRT, power preparation and reception are equally present. Its date avoids equating Sony development prototype with commercial model. [7000,10500): repeated model facts tie early Trinitron story to exact thirteen-inch KV-1310 and Sony sources, avoiding reading the whole product line through later wider sets. Comparison is non-ranking, and maker’s “two times” claim is preserved as promo rather than repurposed as a metric. [10500,14000): KV-1310 closes by retaining the negative distinction between a technology-team award and a single-model award, and by separating display size from quality. AQUOS begins with a domestic placement task, not a claim that all television moved to LCD at once; the easel/stand analogy is anchored to the physical handle and support arrangement. [14000,17500): AQUOS closing language explicitly refuses series-wide reading and the “era transition already complete” narrative, while the measured/branded 450 cd/m² point is marked untested. Frame prose is a domestic interior question (“what after TV?”) and tags the art display as powered, keeping the stylish frame metaphor from erasing its electrical operation. [17500,21000): Frame’s prose uses “what remains on the wall?” as a curatorial problem, then a concrete image-selection workflow; retains that art mode consumes power and that reprint sensor tests were not uniformly reliable. It does not make visual resemblance equal to artwork or infer current app continuity. Exact LS003/region boundaries protect the historical voice from later-series contamination. [21000,24500): Sero text stages a vertical-phone-sharing task, then explains mechanical space and source quality, avoiding a spec-sheet-led story. It explicitly leaves app/network/region compatibility conditional and distinguishes screen resolution from source resolution; regional product and availability records remain unblended. [24500,28000): RX prose centers on an event—screen appears or recedes for a specific activity—and compares three contemporary room strategies without claiming linear inevitability. The negative that display retraction does not remove base/power/audio is central; static page cannot support durability claim. This keeps curatorial comparison concrete while avoiding luxury-image judgement. [28000,31500): compact source records reinforce the distinction between manual-index excerpt and museum inventory for RCA, Japan/Europe product archives and region-scoped LG page. Historical style benefits from naming how claims were bounded; no rights or independent use-testing inferred from catalogue status. [31500,35000): repeated source labels keep the language cautious: manufacturer history is neither independent review nor proof of broad sales/use; hosted magazine test remains distinct and its sample/reprint details unknown. This source-aware phrasing is preserved where the exhibit cites criticism of sensor behavior. [35000,38526): final source notes preserve the hosted reprint’s editorial role and unknown sample/reprint terms; Samsung and LG availability/model archives remain first-party with region limits. Import instructions and validation are procedural assertions, especially deferral of relation links and restricted collection scope; they are not historical text to broaden.

passes.notes: 首段HP-35修订：年份1972、HP/IEEE以及原操作资料的来源分工可见，HP目标故事通过档案转述；模型是科学计算而非普通四则便携器。使用须自选角度制并理解RPN/堆栈，内部照只可描述可见焊接面；M25权利CC BY-SA 4.0但不是拆机教程。文头强调是既有slug修订、未新增数量且未声称新的一手验证。 HP-35 limitations/readerTakeaway补充显示位数与精度有限、RPN需学习，修订仅museum explanation且production不变。Altair 1975定位由CHM和原手册支撑，面板拨杆/灯解释EXAMINE、DEPOSIT、RUN/STOP；断电会丢易失内存，扩展终端不代表基础机自带图形桌面。 Altair readerTakeaway与修订声明明确个人改造/学习成本，挂接已冻结slug。Apple-1从1976年已组装单板切入，标明另备键盘、视频和电源；6502、驻留监控与文本显示从说明书支撑，产品是核心板而不是开箱完整电脑。 Apple-1的monitored输入输出从手册来，外设/电源仍要另配，不能把板卡写成整机；正文反复将便利与组件责任并举。IBM PC 5150标确切发布日与8088、独立键盘、扩展槽；技术资料解释接口开放，配置和软件因订单不同，不假设标准完整系统。 IBM 5150说明型配置而非单一固定能力：80键?文本记述83键、选件安装手册、磁盘/DOS或ROM BASIC路径不同，开放电路资料带来兼容知识责任。Commodore 64标1982，用户指南是启动/BASIC/图形指令与加载操作主来源；64KB系统内存不等于BASIC空闲38,911字节。 C64以BASIC作开机入口，不把程序活动浪漫化为每位用户行为；图形POKE和外接存储都需学习。Macintosh 128K为1984初代，用户指南C:TXM15B支撑鼠标/文件任务；区别于后代Plus，不宣称发明鼠标或首创GUI。Save、400KB软盘换盘与有限内存构成操作及存储边界。 Macintosh限制明确断电未保存内容丢失、400KB单驱动器换盘安排是使用的一部分；图形界面可视化关系，不消除储存/资源管理。iMac G3从最初Bondi Blue版1998叙述，来源包含同期发布资料与原指南；预整合屏幕、扬声器、modem、USB/网络电话线连接是版本事实，网页使用需账户和网络条件。 iMac文字特别拆分机器已整合的modem与仍需账户/服务线路，网络服务非内置承诺；初代缺软驱/ADB/SCSI，旧外设不直接兼容。修订范围museum-only。来源索引开头声明事实支持与原创策展解释不同，引用不提供媒体授权。 来源记录对Macintosh外形只用对象事实，指出馆藏为预生产评估机，不拿其流转史当零售经历，也不用“GUI第一”概括。iMac时间线仅采形态/年份硬件而排除营销排名与经营评价。 来源方法备注具体：IBM 1981手册由PDF/OCR转录但未逐页核图且不借XT；Mac 128K官方规格注明页面模式表异常且不据此推断；手册扫描/OCR有杂字符，避免用含糊段落；iMac产品PDF注明原件保存者和1998版权时间，技术页核Original排除重量/内存争议，Waterloo小模型不能冒充藏品实物。 来源账目末条CWC-S001为HP自有历史页，明确舍弃世界第一/旧价宣传、不自动授权媒体转载、不证明当前可购/可靠性/全球影响；与HP来源彼此独立性的说明不混淆。全文件来源自述用于限定结论，而非新一轮外网核查。

事实/限制复核：HP-35的堆栈输入和函数精度为有限呈现，必须确认角度制与单位，图片许可并不扩展为拆机说明。Altair前面板灯提供状态线索却要求操作者自行找错，断电易失数据。Apple-1板已组装不等于用户无需配置。 HP-35的实际使用不能把数字脱离单位解读；护栏是教学/界限，不夸大自动判断。Altair虽可外接键盘终端，基础版本的断电会丢RAM，输入代码要另存，灯不自动定位错误。 Apple-1使用需要配齐电源、键盘、视频显示；驻留监控只覆盖输入/检验/运行，不等于完整软件环境。CHM年表支持单板/组装史，手册支持接口动作；照片外壳/键盘是否原厂套装不自动推断。 IBM 5150事实约束复核：DOS和磁盘属于配置条件，ROM BASIC是另一条入口，不以单一型号暗示同配置；显示/打印/存储需选件。开放接口便利伴随设置、装载和知识成本，非完全封闭的盒子也不自动兼容每个设备。 C64事实限制包括家用内存的BASIC可用量不同、存档靠外部磁带/磁盘，LOAD还需实体播放步骤；不会宣称每个购买者写代码。来源是指南转录，注明未逐页图像核验。 Macintosh 128K限制复核：规格明确128KB、无扩展槽/硬盘与400KB软盘，单驱动器换盘及手动Save不可省略。C:S18馆藏机是预生产评估机，按发布史定年而不借其藏品流转。原文否定“鼠标/图形界面首创”必须保留，避免重复历史误归。 iMac原始产品PDF/Apple技术页支持Bondi Blue初代具体配置；明确预整合拨号modem仍需要线路、ISP账户和服务，USB不能保证老ADB/SCSI/软驱直接沿用。机器端简化与服务/迁移依赖要同时说。 iMac结尾限制再确认了初版没有软驱/ADB/SCSI，迁移旧介质需要另寻路径；互联网组件只解决电脑端，非服务和线路，固定一体机同时便利与搬运限制。来源C:CH02等均注明事实/解释与媒体权利各异。 来源条目详细提醒苹果Macintosh对象是预生产评估机，因此不能把这件藏品经历写成零售史；不采用“图形界面第一”。iMac museum时间线只核年份/硬件，不借排名宣传。HP-35照片来源只允许观察焊点/形态，不支持元件猜测。 IBM/Apple手册转录有OCR/source限制，1984模式表不作无依据显示结论。iMac原1998产品PDF系保存方提供，技术页排除有争议的重量/内存；Waterloo缩小模型仅支持外观，不是本项目实物来源。来源标注独立性/范围，均不授予媒体权。 两个HP-65辅助来源分别为厂商历史和独立博物馆物件记录，但每项只核登记事实，未核销量、可靠性与图片许可；CWC为HP自有正文，明确剔除“第一”等夸张说法、不能当转载许可。这些口径使对照意义保持有限。

passes.notes: 文风：顶层note先否定新增数量和生产变更，设定档案语气。HP-35以按键、堆栈、单位等具体动词解释抽象计算；“准确的方法仍由人负责”是保留的人机边界。内部照限制只陈述焊点观察、不推断芯片/工艺，权利注说明不构成完整拆机教程，不应删掉。 HP-35段从设计精确转到限制，指出RPN不合代数书写顺序、显示精度有限、数学判断仍在人；这不是贬低而是解释学习负担。Altair段用“易于获得/操作学习代价”做平衡，面板手势细节维持博物馆叙述的触感。 Altair结论用“系统使用”代替“个人电脑革命”宏话，保留组装/学习的双面性。Apple-1段落的“已组装测试核心/仍须外接”对照是主要叙事支点；避免外观图中的机箱、键盘被写成同一原厂套装。 Apple-1通过“买核心电路/完整可用设备之间”总结边界，语气避免把桌面PC先驱说成现代即插即用。IBM用协作平台的词语展开，但随即落到选件和接口任务；处理器不能独立完成办公，结构表述克制。 IBM “不只是性能固定的盒子”收束于部件关系而非商业传奇。C64的句子把即输即见和长期保存拆开，提醒手指操作与介质管理是两件事；正文用“不是每个购买者都编程”防止把文化记忆扩展成普遍用户史。 Macintosh叙述用“屏幕上可见的对象与动作”做总结，并立刻保留软盘空间/换盘成本；短动作序列双击、拖动、Save令读者能跟随，不简化成“鼠标革命”。反复说明GUI不是首次发明是需要保留的历史限定。 iMac写法以Bondi Blue半透明、CRT、提手、USB等形态/接口名词建构，不用审美排名；联网预整合与账户/网络要求形成克制对照。 iMac收尾反复区分预置设备和外部服务，及减少布线与取消迁移不是同一回事；这些明确否定可防“开箱即用互联网”过度说法。源头标题和版权信息保留采购/档案关系。 SMG和CHM条目的叙述边界具体，分别排除预生产评估经历、营销排名；来源陈述本身示范审慎措辞。HP-35焊接面照片仅供看见的走线/焊点，不能据此猜芯片。 IBM手册提取/OCR与MAC说明书OCR杂字符被明确记录，且不绕过访问门槛；iMac产品PDF保留原始发布日期/保存者，缩小模型/外观页面不冒充实物。稿件语气应该继承这种可追溯而克制的来源说明。 来源表末条为厂商本体历史，明确局限只核字段事实且不外授图片权，排除世界第一/历史价。这种否定保留了资料可信边界。

BY3.0、需署名，尽管类别GFDL与迁移冗余也出现；显式PermissionTicket是重要且高优先级记录。下一图也是Mod II拆盖后的upper-rear视图，意味着有不同拍摄角度，须逐项读其描述、来源与许可。 第二张Mod II expose视图明确说top plate/设备上盖移除，拍摄2006-06-27，credit Courtesy BY3.0但没有单列Attribution字段，须把VRT批准与License标记一并留存。其前视图的描述说控制板未接线、摄像镜头顶部中央并且扬声器只“几乎可见”，原文的谨慎程度是可用线索。下一张编号012，标题专指相机与反射镜特写。 012相机+反射镜caption将功能写成推测“may have been used to image documents”，不可改写为确证用途；拍摄日期Unknown date, circa June 2006，强调日期不确定。编号和标题十分具体，直指Mod II而非通用PicturePhone。 镜面特写使用与同组相同的VRT存档授权票，确认权利人邮件许可；该部分模板文案高度重复，仍应保留每个图的票号关联，而不能由图像类别误推所有作者作品都统一适用。 012相机镜像文件许可最终CC BY3.0，归属字段显式required true，许可URL；描述中“may have been used”保留推测。接下来另一候选标题是1969 AT&T Picturephone Model 2，在Early Television Museum拍于June 2022；名称Model 2与Mod II可能相关但需metadata论证型号，不能凭标题定性。 最后一项标题称1969 Picturephone Model 2，而图像description只泛称AT&T Picturephone，配套信息为Early Television Museum、实拍2022-06-19、摄影者DogsRNice、CC BY-SA4.0。必须区分title对Model2/1969的识别与description本身没有型号说明的证据层级。

目标区别写得具体：美国匹兹堡商业服务设备，不收录1964 ModI展览电话；搜索只按标题。候选视频有历史叙述但不能以其1964 broad PicturePhone为Mod II事实。DateTime与DateTimeOriginal差约5小时，同日上载/拍录；许可状态需要下一段完整元数据确认。 视频可在CC BY-SA3.0下再用，必须署名、链接、说明改动，改作相同兼容许可；rights字段Copyrighted True，Restrictions空。此许可判断只针对视频，不代表片中素材权利独立复核。下一广告类别PD US no notice，后续要看创作/扫描日期和说明。 广告文件明确标Public domain/no notice，Attribution false、Restrictions空、LicenseUrl没有；Credit是self-scanned、Artist为AT&T Bell。条目描述说1970 Esquire广告，commons页面DateTimeOriginal记2020 scan date，二者不能混淆。 序列铭牌照片的日期、来源字段仍明示2006-06-27及LabguysWorld.com/Richard Diehl；许可依据不是猜测或后续自述，而是同组VRT Ticket 2009101910061435，需要阅读全文确认批准条件。 VRT statement confirms general permission to reuse if page license conditions are met, copyright holder approval was emailed to WMF and reviewed by team; ticket is visible only to trusted volunteers. This distinguishes verified permission basis from a public open email. 铭牌照最终许可CC BY3.0并需署名、许可链接；Rights & Restrictions字段呈现Copyrighted true且空restrictions。另一个cover-removed候选DateTime页面时间2009-10-20，接下来需区分它实际拍摄/许可条件。 upper-rear ModII图许可给CC BY3.0并且AttributionRequired true，具体要求Courtesy LabguysWorld.com；页内“可自选许可”与明确采用的许可并列，实际重用应按所列CC BY3.0遵守。其他角度项也是同组作者但要分别核验描述和授权。 斜视照片明确限于主机，桌下常用的1A service unit和pad-to-phone wiring均不在图片中；对于拟介绍完整商业终端的页面，这是关键操作性限制。许可需等待同编号VRT部分后确认归属语句。 同一VRT票据的文字再次明确：版权方邮件批准按该页许可发布，VRT review后归档；这支持非commercial归档页外复用前仍依许可条件履约。通用文字长且重复，具体许可文本仍是决定条件。 upper RH图最终许可CC BY3.0并要求署名Courtesy LabguysWorld.com，限制字段为空；机身角度记录仍声明没包含1A unit和接线，许可不会补足画面缺口。011前upper quarter数据时间为Commons 2009-10-19，原拍摄日期未知约2009，不能将编辑时间当拍摄日。 前上视角显示摄像头顶部居中、右上扬声器仅若隐若现；控制板未接线，拍摄circa 2009而非精确日期。此类可见事实以“almost seen”避免硬说完整确认。 该条再次引用票2009101910061435，VRT已审查权利人邮件并收档，不仅仅是普通自我声明；但许可条件在单独license字段定义。 前视角项的最终许可CC BY3.0并要求署名/许可链接，VRT ticket 2009101910061435支持页面许可；同条说明设备控制板无接线。相机反射镜项的拍摄约June 2006仍是估计值。 相机与reflector mirror候选明确是1972–73 Mod II，日期约June 2006而非精确日；caption对镜子功能仅作may-have-been推断。资料显示艺术家名、网站署名credit相互一致。 相机许可仍是同一票据验证的许可，不是“free”即可忽略归属；后面CC BY3.0要求应结合作者和许可链接。 镜头特写许可CC BY3.0需署名（这里仅在组内metadata有artist与credit），同票VRT已确认发布批准。镜功能仍是推断表达。末候选标题以1969标称为Model 2，需避免与72–73标注Mod II混淆。 Museum照为2022拍摄、摄影者DogsRNice，BY-SA4.0需署名并share-alike。尽管文件名称1969 Model 2，description只有“AT&T Picturephone”，无自身型号说明，准确表述要明确分类来源是标题而非caption。

passes.focus: 逐句文风及必要否定/历史保留理由
passes.notes: 目标中文限定语非常关键，明确排除1964 Mod I；检索表达则是通用Picturephone，二者之间存在刻意的版本筛选。首候选科普视频标题采用戏剧化措辞“lost a half billion”“nearly created the internet”，caption又声称“most revolutionary medium”与“failed miserably”，属于作者叙事性评价，不能当作中立档案原话采纳。 这条视频整段caption有情绪化和对照句（“amazing achievement”“failed miserably”“not broadband lines like today”），把研究性限定收紧为视频自身说法才不会让营销式调子变成无来源事实。艺术家是William S. Hammack，许可CC BY-SA3.0。广告候选标题声称1970，需看原caption能否确认实为广告年份还是Commons日期。 广告说明仅称“announcing commercial availability of video phone service”，沒有声称具体Mod II；应依据图名/内容身份谨慎命名。短描述、self-scanned及AT&T Bell署名体现文献扫描而非现场物照，历史发布日期不可用Commons扫描日覆盖。 铭牌 caption语法略为生硬（“-view showing…”），但设备开放后顶部铭牌不可见这一限定是重要历史视角信息。署名同时写LabguysWorld.com credit和Labguy别名Richard Diehl artist；不要压缩掉作者名与来源站区分。 三张LabguysWorld.com来源图共用模板化VRT说明，而这里重新读到仍是号码2009101910061435；它说明权利人许可publication，前句强调按页面许可使用，不应截成无条件“free”. 铭牌照的核心描述和许可字段均支持可用，但目的为展示serial plate，且只有拆下console cover才看得到；历史陈列宜写明这一特殊维护/拆解状态。下项名称明确exposed upper-rear，也是相同拆盖状态但不同后部视角。 upper-rear照片用caption直称Mod II of 1972–73，句子短而直述去盖状态；Credit机构站点、Artist个人化名同时列出。许可中“you may select”属于授权方的开放措辞，实际给出的CC BY3.0还需说明署名Courtesy。下一斜视图更具长篇场景限定。 斜视caption依次确认键盘套在圆形底座，再用Note/Also note有意标出无1A service box和无键盘接线；这些否定不是可忽略赘语，而是界定照片所能支持的配置范围。日期2006-06-27精确，署名仍双列。 同一系列VRT文本说明版权方支持发布，保存到许可档案；这让多张归属LabguysWorld.com的机身照片形成一致的授权来源链。页面不是机主信息的原始档案，无须把VRT许可误当机器登记证明。 上右图的成句包含“these photos”，将遗漏服务盒与线缆说成系列性现状而非单幅误差；需在各角度实际展示时标清缺失。编号011随后caption较短，注意日期未知比Commons上传日期更具决定性。 前上角度描述按顺序交代unwired control pad、speaker almost visible、lens at top centre，使用限定词almost并明确circa 2009；若重新写注释不能把不确定的扬声器可见程度抹平。 尽管VRT提示重复，确保对011条已按本遍再次实际复读；授权归属者范围仍是单张image/license，不可省略。 前视角许可字段仍将BY3.0及AttributionRequired true列出；VRT条款后再由结构化metadata归纳相同许可。条目中两个不同日期一个是上传约2009、一个拍摄约2009，语义都不是精确到日。 012 caption的“may have been used”不可改成确定的文档扫描功能，日期的circa也需保留。编号/型号和摄影者/网站来源双重明示，虽照片局部但可做camera/mirror细节图。 再读该机镜头页VRT内容，仍为统一票号批准发布/可自由使用但必须遵循许可规则；票据仅trusted volunteers可查看。 相机镜面照许可实际CC BY3.0并需署名，描述用途仍是推测、日期约2006。最后博物馆照题名采用“1969 ... Model 2”较具体，而caption“AT&T Picturephone”较泛，支持它入选要保持证据来源区别。 最后一张caption只有“AT&T Picturephone”，没有Model 2；标题/文件名提供1969和Model 2，且日期对应实拍2022-06-19于Early Television Museum。其CC BY-SA4.0要求署名并适用分享相同条款。保留caption和文件名的差别，避免超出证据。

passes.focus: 逐句文风及必要否定和历史保留
passes.notes: 第三遍逐句检查VPJ-700五节语言：将“历史商品/真实任务”落到日本版本和投影面操作，未套无线或自动校正；100lm与重量保留为原厂值，不以重量直接推个人携带能力。首段产品状态和40件基数信息为必要范围边界。 VPJ-700在附加字段中仍仅关联既定XEL-1与Freestyle建议，媒体为空、ID等待主协调；Freestyle开篇把“便携”拆为转向/供电/墙面三要件，且不把原厂最大尺寸等同推荐尺寸。 Freestyle元数据确认官方预订/已售资料分别支撑功能与销售范围，展品状态仍仅文字验证；LG Go语言围绕打开、旋转、收纳来写，电池上限附条件并明确型号不借后代。 LG Go字段仍标清8月计划，不误读为实际交货；source/relationship/媒体状态与文案主张对应。M5强调无线不是无电源，关联提案并不意味着同一连接技术。 M5末尾仅把促销视为商业供应观察，不下首售/库存推断。R95H继续用精确地区型号和背光术语建立说明，不把RGB作为优劣结论。 R95H文字再次强调规格非独立画质测量、公告不等于到货，删除营销式必然主流断言；后继VIVE内容尚未展开。 VIVE叙述把“沉浸”具体化为安装、布置区域、佩戴和输入，并明确房间物件仍在；首批发货不等于日本后续实体渠道。对限定词作保留，避免泛化追踪效果。 HoloLens 2再次以2019标准版定位，近距与远距输入依次解释，直接指出透视不等于全视野覆盖，手势不等于随意挥手；避免将后期能力倒灌首发。 HoloLens字段里关联提议、媒体fallback和内容状态各自列明；来源部分可见CWI支持资料的准确覆盖与软件更新限制，避免来源自身宣传属性被隐去。 Pass3逐项审查厂商来源自身属性：Samsung/Epson索引不冒充独立证据；LG产品页中型号与电池声明保留其可支持范围，奖项数据库也不拿来替代实际表现。 文件尾部保留细粒度来源边界、促销/预订/公告等不同事件种类、产品状态待导入和主线程分配ID等流程约束；没有把档案商业资料写成独立测量。

passes.focus: 事实证据、许可与操作限制
passes.notes: 第2遍：G1文章中将原厂上市回顾与英文套装手册分工，明确手册仅支持机身共通功能、不验证电池续航、旧机状态或地区套装；G1核心事实是Micro Four Thirds/Live MOS、EVF和可调LCD，限于任务和版本。；E-P1明显把六月公告与十一月确认已售拆开，日期只到可证年份；对“最小/最轻”限定为当时厂商比较。Live Control靠图标和拨盘而非触屏，且未导入后续EVF附件。；E-P1事实把公告与已售原厂资料对应到不同sourceIds，相关稿源同篇备份入口不视为独立。X100与Fujifilm财报及原手册分别支持上市/共通取景操作；本遍确认固定镜头和混合取景的证据范围。；X100版本事实只指初代，不借后代规格或系列延续推断在售/支持；对微距电子切换、光学视差和EVF延迟的描述须连同手册限制。Phantom注明US Austin公告附经销购买入口，不把它扩大为全球销售起点。；Phantom在记录中反复否定全场景安全返航、避障能力，late manual只证明共通准备，不等于首发全部固件功能；无具体地点/旧电池适航判断。GR III转入公告与评测来源分工，日期是announcement而非销售。；GR III限制明确不把触摸LCD/防抖当长焦替代，标准款与x/HDF分开；DPReview好坏意见并陈，声明未完整逐页复测或确认全部样机利益关系。；X5的精度限制不止推广语：裁切视角不是全景原分辨率；拼接、遮挡与后期工作量并列可换镜片维护要求。评测字段限定iPhone13编辑、短时试用与潜在佣金。；TZ300文章把德国公告、随后借测体验与销售时间区分，型号地域限制单列，光学范围参数和使用便利分别说明。；各展品媒介信息都作为范围证据而非绝对评价，展示`mediaStatus`文字回退及策展脉络；来源表前段区分同篇备份公告和晚期手册适用边界。；来源记录将厂家档案和媒体评价独立性分开，不以厂商公告验证独立体验。GR III的发布声明来自厂商、评论来自DPReview；X5原厂型号记录与TechRadar带佣金评测分开。；来源字段进一步区分文体与核验深度（正文读取、索引摘录、原始手册），也保存对广告利益/样机条件的未知，不把缺失写成无利益关系。；原厂TZ300公告只证明型号、德国日期和规格，不是独立评价；Phantom两个公告同一发布方，一个原文一个索引，未涉及图片许可或独立效果。导入说明限制数据集合、ID赋值和未决关联。

passes.focus: 逐句文风候选及保留必要否定/历史原文理由
passes.notes: 第3遍：整份档案采用“完整文本已核、未导入”状态和五节产品叙述；首条G1以小任务开篇，条理从机身系统到拍摄流程，再以电源、旧器材状态等限制收束。保留“无反”需按取景链路解释的原句，避免把分类标签当功能本身。；E-P1逐句保留“六月计划、十一月实售确认”的时间差；Live Control拨盘的非触摸限定是必要否定。复古品牌名和电子成像并置，避免把外观风格写成内部机械结构。；E-P1事实源是6月公告加11月已售确认，CWI同篇原公告不是独立证据。X100文本反复把“光学现场”和“镜头画面电子反馈”分开，微距视差是具体而非泛泛的限制。；X100关联E-P1/GR III用于展示操作差异，不写“复古=专业”；样机序列、上市时间和生产事件分开。Phantom从2013 Austin事件叙述飞行摄影任务，但悬挂外置GoPro与后代云台明确分离。；Phantom操作段的指令风格是前置检查序列，随即将镜头录像和起飞分作两个动作；后文保留“失联返航不等于避障”以及不对旧机/地点作适飞判断的关键否定。；GR III最后段节奏是先列无长焦/无闪光/电池等反面，再解释评测覆盖深度和固件边界；用“由实际需要决定”避免给出无证据适用判断。；X5写法以“先记录、后选观看方向”阐述任务，随即明确8K全景与裁切视角的区别；媒体试用条件包括iPhone 13与三类场景，使用便利不等于不需构图。；X5的媒体观察被明示为数日、含佣金链接而样机来源未核，未写成长期耐久结论。TZ300用游客行程的宽至长焦两个具体画面解释产品，而不仅抄规格。；TZ300的详情结构字段保持作者、文章日期、型号条件、优缺点、借测与链接佣金；延迟关联Canon Powershot明确不生成关系链接。；来源栏以publisher、verificationMethod、limits、independence、commercialDisclosure固定层次，使用“厂商自述，不视作独立评价”避免误读。；GR III媒体作者、日期、评测范围和样机不确定信息均原样保留；X5的编辑媒体与原厂公告明确分层，避免把促销正文作为中立规格。；Phantom来源记录最后强调两个同日DJI页面不是独立媒体，且不是图片许可。导入指令以明确动词限制扩充集合、ID/类别、编年阶段和延期关联，最后validation列举机械检查项目。

passes.notes: Pass 1 [0,3500): Markdown is a six-exhibit planning packet checked 2026-10-11, explicitly not imported; preserves 40-item base and distinguishes suggested page placement from actual chronology edits. First CDP-101 dates to Japanese debut 1982-10-01, with other markets unresolved; source references include maker history/manual mirrors and two contemporaneous reviews. Its assertions distinguish protocol/record supply from broad household adoption. The first five-section entry has clear 1982 model/date boundary and separates manual, service documentation, Stereophile and Audio mirror source roles. [3500,7000): CDP-101 closing has market/date/power uncertainties, image rights not yet cleared, and only curated collection link suggestions; product remains text-only. F-91W begins with 1989 product-line launch year (no exact day), standard black exterior, current 593-module guidance not proof of 1989 unit. Design source is designer recollection, Casio specs/manual and IEEE retrospective; one CROWN user memoir is not evidence of military-wide issue. [7000,10500): F-91W close preserves unresolved exact 1989 date, current-vs-original module gap, no official issue/representativeness inference, and photo rights pending. ThinkPad 701C follows as specific US 75MHz/540MB UT5, March 1995 available and Dec withdrawal; 701CS passive screen and UT2 excluded. IBM history and manual mirror support function/market context, MoMA record is series-level design accession not UT5 proof or award. [10500,14000): Nokia original 2000 model is announcement date 2000-09-01 and planned Q4 supply; the museum record is one UK O2 SIM specimen, not local retail date. Nokia release/manual plus a bounded mobile-interaction study support interface behavior; “indestructible” lore is explicitly rejected. MX Master 3 begins as right-handed 2019 original, announced Sep 4 with sales timing only planned; exclude 3S/Mac variants. [14000,17500): MX Master 3 is Sep 2019 original, right-handed, non-3S/non-Mac. Logitech support outlines connect/configure, Unifying/Bluetooth, Flow software dependence; USB-C charging is not pointer data. Red Dot standard product award is distinguished from ergonomic/medical evidence; RTINGS reviewer scope and user hand-size limits noted. Framework begins first-gen 13.5-inch, 11th-gen Intel; May US/June Canada preorder vs July first shipment distinctions. [17500,21000): Framework source story uses 2021 first-gen 11th-gen Intel, July shipping (February announcement), region preorders separate; 2022 iFixit board swap is an actual later upgrade rather than launch configuration. Red Dot 2022 award is Best of the Best, TIME selection and iFixit upgrade are different kinds of evidence. DIY and preinstalled editions differentiated. [21000,24500): Framework narrative treats right to repair as a proposition supported by doc/parts plus one real 2022 board swap; not all machines or years, and repairability not equal plug-and-play. Exact first shipment, pre-order timing and region/config distinctions stay separate. Source ledger begins with Sony primary/manual plus contemporaneous review roles and early F-91W product-line/manual/interview distinctions. [24500,28000): F-91W source bundle separates 1989 product line, current black 593-module specs, designer interview and editorial retrospective; unit manufacture/version gap remains. ThinkPad source limits UT5 specifics to compiled IBM reference; MoMA is series-level and donated, image rights not granted. Nokia release, museum object, 2004 manual, and interaction research cover different contexts; O2 SIM object cannot establish universal use. [28000,31500): Nokia experiment was context-sensitive and only for 3310/5510 in specific lab/street environments. MX source ledger differentiates brand launch plan, support guide, Red Dot ordinary award and RTINGS hands-on review; model-specific and time scoped. Framework intro is first-gen source, later navbar stripped; shipping announcement says July batch/first deliveries, TIME annual selection is editorial, not test/award. [31500,33425): Framework DIY guide is current rev covering 11th/12th gen, not 2021 release; iFixit documents one later swap, Red Dot confirms 2022 Best of Best, Ars 2021 review is one i7 sample and splits gaming comparison. Source limitations preserve unknown samples/relationships. Footer proposes only four chronicle nodes and no layout/site alteration; image assets remain pending and text fallback.

Pass 2 [0,3500): CDP narrative is responsibly bounded to Japanese date, not regional voltage; contemporaneous reviews are linked to individual test units and sample/loan conditions. Manual mirror has unreadable pages and is not claimed fully transcribed; no image license, current condition or universal sound claim. The packet says append-only, not site-imported, and collections remain 40 pending baseline verification. [3500,7000): F-91W source timeline is 1989 line launch with undated original unit; current 593 guide explains operations, not 1989 module. Personal military-use anecdote is strictly one author, not force-wide issue. Warranty/water language only says Water Resistant; no depth rating or unqualified durability. Sales-page battery life is conditional. [7000,10500): ThinkPad source-specific evidence: UT5 is 75MHz/540MB US configuration available Mar95; 701C withdrawn Dec95. IBM narrative identifies growing screens and production delay but does not establish a hardware-failure or consumer-rejection cause. Do not assign MoMA series record to UT5 or translate its collection into unverified iF award. [10500,14000): Nokia date is public announcement (Sep 1) and Q4 supply plan; museum O2-SIM specimen establishes its identity, not local sale or mass adoption. User guide is a 2004 revised copy and cannot prove every software behavior at launch. Network/SIM/operator dependence, contextual study scope and manual cautions are stated; the familiar “unbreakable” myth is explicitly unsupported. [14000,17500): MX Master 3 is original 2019 non-3S, with launch but plan-vs-actual retail distinction. USB-C charging is explicitly not wired data; Flow software required on both PCs. Red Dot 2020 ordinary Product Design award—not a medical/ergonomic outcome or iF/Chicago award; RTINGS hand-size and use-case boundaries retained. Firmware/OS compatibility needs current recheck and is not claimed. [17500,21000): Framework recognizes current official guide includes both gen11/12 revisions and is not a 2021 original manual. Later iFixit board swap proves one compatible upgrade only; it does not establish fleet reliability, lifetime or environmental benefit. Red Dot is 2022 Best of the Best. Repair instructions are described as evidence, not followed here. [21000,24500): Framework entry uses shipping announcement not later reported opening/preorder to anchor date; one real iFixit replacement is direct upgrade evidence, not systematic repair-rate evidence. Source catalogue differentiates 2021 announcement, 2021 ship date, 2023/2024-current guide revisions, single iFixit sample, Red Dot award and one Ars review. Current guide not treated as contemporaneous. [24500,28000): Casio official heritage validates product-line date; current page can’t prove original batch, designer interview conflicts on date and its military story is one anecdote. ThinkPad original reference is a mirrored multi-configuration manual but UT5 fields explicitly selected; MoMA design record not model-specific award. Nokia museum object is O2-SIM UK specimen with noncommercial image terms, manual is 2004 revision, and no reprint/image license implied. [28000,31500): the mobile interaction study is a two-context, two-model experiment, not population-wide reliability or usability evidence. MX source scope differentiates announcement plans from actual retail and confirms USB-C is charge-only; the award is original 3 (not 3S), reviewer methodology date differs from initial article. Framework source reprint records actual revision timing and one replacement episode. [31500,33425): Framework guide is current multi-generation revision; one iFixit swap, award record and independent review each have specific roles/limits. The closing four proposed chronicle nodes do not claim current site modification; media remains text fallback pending verified rights and physical model match.

passes.notes: Pass 3 [0,3500): Markdown opens with explicit append-only scope and separates a cultural-product proposal from implemented chronology. CDP-101 prose moves from format/supply to physical loading and selection tasks; the comparison with vinyl is marked curatorial, not a performance hierarchy. Preserve model/market date distinction and the strong negative against claiming whole-home adoption from launch. The evidence-based sequence and photo-license pending notice justify retaining the no-photo placeholder. [3500,7000): F-91W prose explains ordinary usefulness as an alternative to feature accumulation, not the one correct watch; paired comparison with Pulsar and Apple Watch is deliberately interpretive. Preserve negative qualifications on popularity, military issue, original module equivalence, water depth and durability: they keep a familiar cultural image from becoming pseudo-statistics. [7000,10500): F-91W’s text-only note and no exact-date caveat are important; 701C enters through physical transformation of keyboard. It shifts from mechanism to practical lap/desk state, then preserves MoMA series vs UT5 distinction. The “not better outcome, only explainable tradeoff” phrasing avoids equating museum recognition, rarity or complexity with quality. [10500,14000): Nokia entry deliberately avoids evolutionary teleology (does not require category creation or position later phone as sole destination). The walkthrough breaks entry, addressing, editing and send confirmation into learnable actions. A 2004 manual and small field experiment support distinct contexts, not launch firmware or everybody’s proficiency. Myth-denial and maintenance advice belong in historical record. [14000,17500): MX prose treats peripheral as labor interface, not an automatic progress marker; design uses gesture-to-control mapping. The award is just evidence of institutional attention and not a medical claim. USB-C “charge only” is an essential negative. User configuration/software and hand-size tradeoffs ensure it is not framed as universal best. [17500,21000): Framework prose names repair as one route rather than a guaranteed outcome; the single board swap is used as concrete evidence but not a lifetime/reliability claim. It preserves original-vs-upgraded processor distinction and the non-intuitive delicate ribbon/antenna details. The negative that narrative is not a repair manual matters because these are archival notes, not procedural instruction. [21000,24500): Framework curatorial prose links long-term care to specific steps and documented parts; avoids ranking CPU generation or universal repairability. It retains manual fragility and one-example boundary. The file’s source-register transition makes these limits auditable rather than treating every link as equal corroboration. [24500,28000): evidence statements are carefully sectioned by source: current Casio specs vs original 1989 date, IBM maker history vs MoMA series catalog vs mirror manual UT5 specifics, Nokia release vs O2 specimen/manual revision. Rights caveats remain explicit, with noncommercial photo terms and no presumption that a visible web record licenses republishing. [28000,31500): source section has a deliberate evidence ladder: Nokia field study limited to its experimental setting; MX launch/support/award/independent test are not interchangeable; Framework edit selection vs manufacturer release vs manual vs a later repair vs award are separately labelled. Preserve those distinctions in any downstream reading. Final source segment distinguishes source roles and limits: Framework DIY guide is a 2023-11-02 visible revision spanning 11th/12th gen and cannot represent 2021 documentation; iFixit confirms one 2022 board swap with commercial repair-tool context and unknown brand payment; Red Dot records 2022 Best of the Best as design recognition, not performance evidence; Ars is one 2021 i7 sample and gaming-specific comparison, with sponsorship/sample terms incomplete. The packet preserves those caveats and does not treat source suggestions as imports.

[0,3500)：段落以“一个具体任务”进入，反复把器材史锚定在用户动作上，适合候选风格但不应把所有条目机械统一成同句模板。F3的上下文保留“旗舰”和厂商讨论可靠性的历史语境，同时limitations有必要否定：设计目标不能证明现存机况；F3HP/NASA及MD-4的排除防止把特殊版本/附件写入普通产品。胶片冲洗、低照度快门及电池依赖都是刻意保留的条件，避免把电子化写成全自动或数字化。 Pass3 [3500,7000)：F3的related-slug、proposed ID和text-fallback状态是流程元信息，保留便于追踪待导入提案，不应润饰成面向观众的事实句。CCD-V8靠“感知—磁带记录”对照拆解数字化概念；保留不等同手机视频的否定、地区型号边界和旧带状态限制，避免把现代体验投射到原机。 Pass3 [7000,10500)：RC-701句式把感知/保存/输出分开，适合作为准确表达模板；“不等于数字文件”是核心必要否定，不可为简洁而删。保留1984实验机与1986商品区分避免倒置史实，FD适配器条件避免造成误操作印象；“不必写成失败前的错误尝试”是有意抵抗目的论的策展语气，允许历史路径保持自身任务价值。 Pass3 [10500,14000)：facts将日期/版本/模拟记录/适配器事实拆成可追溯条目，适合保留简洁字段而不丢来源映射。EOS650采用动作序列说明装片、合焦和过片；文字把“自动化”限于具体劳动，不声称替人作构图/焦点判断。EF与胶片的描述保留必要否定（电子控制仍非数字摄影），QD版另列。 Pass3 [14000,17500)：EOS650把厂商“无可比拟”直接标为未采用的营销评价，采用可验证的控制结构解释便利，值得保留的中性取舍。对焦/曝光与光线主体/手抖的限制、2CR5供电、FD镜头不兼容、USM不泛化、初版不含QD以及手册正文不可读等否定，构成避免产品宣传过度的必要边界。 Pass3 [17500,21000)：TR55以旅行短片任务具象说明握持布局，提法可借鉴但“好拿”有意不泛化到所有手型。原厂设计意图与独立长期体验分开，790g不代表全携带重量，TR5/TR55E/后代屏幕菜单均明确排除。磁带顺序访问、供电、播放设备和旧媒体状态是必要保存条件，需避免把机身变轻等同整体使用负担消失。 Pass3 [21000,24500)：DCS段落通过“数字背—外部DSU—F3”的分工避免把系统误写成一体机；保留DCS与后称DCS100、1991发布与1990馆藏制造两个区分。列明不补现代屏幕/卡/容量/协议、未运行系统并待铭牌核对，是有根据的必要否定；“全球唯一首创/数量排名”未证即不写，原厂新闻用途仍注明独立材料未量化效率。 Pass3 [35000,38500)：S036和S037都保留Sony检索索引的范围与原厂宣传属性，重复使用不会构成独立证据。Nikon S040/S042的packet标签交叉映射是来源链而非两份验证；文风审读以字段级“谁支持哪句”来追溯，不把扁平重复元数据当叙述正文。 Pass3 [42000,45788)：CCD-TR55厂商设计档案限核790g和布局；Kodak厂商里程碑宣传保留但不沿用其可能拔高的唯一首创/排名语气。独立馆藏编目只支持该件1990制造的具体组成，图片权利仍单独授权；最后的导入顺序/重复检查文字作为历史流程保留但未执行。字段证据范围、照片许可边界和年月区别都是今后编辑必须保留的限定。

passes.notes: Style pass: H-5 uses a tactile action sequence (choose, process, observe, stop, collect, clean) to explain labor-sharing without claiming social transformation. Its comparisons to later Model K and rice cooker are bounded and concrete. Keep the “no manual” sentence, equipment-condition caveat, and refusal of power/speed/capacity claims; these are substantive historical limits, not hedging to polish away.  Toastmaster prose remains in ordinary task terms (load, wait, see pop-up, decide doneness, clean crumbs) rather than turning a single object into a societal “turning point.” Keep the exact dating uncertainty, index/direct-server-error disclosure, absent performance measurements, and explicit nontransfer of 1A4/modern functions. The pop-up metaphor is useful because the limit follows immediately.  The metadata/source IDs reinforce that a reviewed text packet is not a completed import: no hero media, no chronicle entry, related objects only proposals and explicit scope limits. A700’s voice avoids “first” contests and translates planetary motion into visible hand/tool relations; retain caveats about later models, modern videos, unverified accessories and absent matched manual.  A700 conclusion explicitly leaves live-power display to a separate inspection and does not promise processing across arbitrary food. Preserve repair-history qualification because the surviving attachments may not match original retail sets. EC-36 prose uses a different human/machine boundary—controlled heat, with preparation/serving/cleaning retained—rather than suggesting total domestic automation; keep distinction from Toshiba ER-4.  EC-36’s close keeps its important negatives: no matched full manual, no controlled cooking data, no measured time/energy/texture benefit, no pressure system, no later microcomputer functions. The grounded value is its heat-control arrangement. New R-10 prose shifts to a commercial workflow and preserves “not household counter model” as an interpretive constraint, not a universal user claim.  R-10 significance presents it as a machine inserted into pre-existing staff tasks, and specifically resists treating corporate success claims as proof. Keep the 2025 promotional retrospective’s unquantified feedback, no operating/manual data, no performance comparison, and no demo clearance. Next DC01 language contrasts collection mechanism with human pushing, framed as interpretation not an efficiency/health test.  DC01 care prose follows manual sequence but stays at task level, excluding procedure detail and service info; the required drying condition is retained so “transparent/removable” does not imply rinse-anything. The interpretive sentence about a visible bin is expressly separated from tested cleaning performance, and it avoids allergy/health inference and present-day reliability.  Model 500 style relies on the readable dial geometry and familiar hand sequence, but avoids heroic “revolution” language. Its limitations preserve absent contemporaneous manual, no tested surviving unit, no universal market access or electrical compatibility, and later color variants are not retroactively attributed. Accessibility is contextual, not generalized.  Style pass over source registry confirms that its templated prose (“verification” repeated from fields) is data provenance rather than exhibit voice; no need to normalize archival entries. Preserve distinct source genres: later service manual, corporate retrospective, index-only museum comparison.  Registry voice is deliberately documentary and repeats explicit nonverification rather than making smoother but stronger claims; keep that provenance trail because it explains why individual historical sentences stay qualified.  Panasonic’s two same-company sources serve different purposes, one specific to the 1956 product and one broad chronology; Sharp history remains brand narrative while the hosted industrial archive was submitted by Sharp. Preserving those provenance differences prevents overstatement.  Style review of provenance notes shows model-bound source descriptions are useful restraint; Kenwood’s dating page is sales support and its history brand-promotional, while the telephone gallery comes from a separate museum. Do not smooth away disclosures or imply independent corroboration where sources share a publisher.  Final registry keeps source independence/commercial disclosure explicit, including the Westport museum’s altered photo background and Dyson corporate/designer memoir limits. ImportInstructions are workflow text and were not acted upon; their useful caution is that IDs must be checked and this packet is not itself a merge. Third pass now covers [0,45440) continuously.

[0-3500] 第三遍逐句观察：正文以“原日本”“具体软件”“部分作品”等范围词压住泛化，并把制作人回忆定位为有归属的视角；保留“不是对任何手型都舒适的验证”这一必要否定，免得采访被读成用户研究。
[3500-7000] 风格逐句观察N64部分：公认平台事实把G150-S012限于年份，紧接手册仅给操作例；“不借其版本确认日本所有软件”以及“不是…全部游戏统一增强”保留了重要排除。配件应看作软件/连接条件下可用，避免功能清单误读。
[7000-10500] 文风候选GBC：按三种卡带类别逐步展开，避免用笼统“兼容”遮蔽方向差异；颜色不把壳体颜色拆成展品，也不写作新旧设备简单替代。证据限制保留专用卡带兼容尚未作为已核事实的边界，避免把修辞顺畅误当证据充分。
[10500-14000] 第三遍GBC审语言节奏：先拆分类再讲价值，避免“革命/优秀”等未经证据的夸赞；保留“不是剧烈转折”“不能由宣传推出所有人觉得升级必要”两处否定，说明这是有意抵抗品牌叙事。限制还拒绝倒灌后代背光/服务。
[14000-17500] pass3 GBA措辞：手册步骤写作“建议在有适当光照处改变持握角度”，保留其作为建议而非硬性操作；对线材不混用、关机换卡、旧内容画面/声音差异的提醒明确且必要。避免把便携误说成不依赖环境。
[17500-21000] GameCube第三遍逐句：原代日本版本、后期美洲操作补充之间的界线持续出现；“不需要被写成所有家庭都采用的标准”“不等同每位使用者更喜欢”等否定保留了非普遍性。用“任务分工”组织盘片、控制、存档与电视，简洁且不夸技术首创。
[21000-24500] 3DS行文强调技术名词须落到版本/操作：以CTR-001与手册作为具体范围，保留“非New3DS/2DS”“只有支持作品才立体”“不承诺今日服务”等限制。第三遍确认这些否定贯穿而非附会，可以避免把型号能力泛化为整个产品家族。
[24500-28000] Wii U第三遍句式用“不能由外形相似直接判定”澄清类别，并把双屏分工写成观众可以观察的问题而非成功宣称；GamePad独立充电但仍依赖主机，是核心必要限制。欧洲手册年份是2017，保留历史服务不能外推的否定。
[28000-31500] 本段转Switch Lite；逐句风格将其定义为“实质不同的设备安排”，而不靠性能排名或单纯缩小说法。原厂携带定位与当前FAQ兼容说明分源，解释为展览问题而不是品牌购买建议；这一编排值得保留。
[31500-35000] Switch Lite文风强调“固定输入”“不支持电视输出”这些可核差异，而不是颜色/容量；又保留无线外控和另购支架条件，随后明确未测试续航、舒适。策展解读呈现可选择任务，不把便携营销转化为普遍体验评价。
[35000-38500] 第三遍对来源目录逐句留意文风与保留理由：标题称“原厂/支持资料”，limits统一反复说明不是独立评测、不套当前手册功能；个别条目又另加更细限制（AGB不用SP背光、GameCube美国手册不证明日机）。这些差异具体而不可压缩成模板免责声明。
[38500-42000] 逐句保留来源时期限定：CTR-001日本手册没有New3DS/未来服务；2017 WiiU手册不回填2012；Lite当前FAQ清楚标“当前”。G150厂商档案被限定为日期/类别而非普遍体验。反复声明第一方并非冗余：它关系证据独立性。
[42000-43040] 收尾第三遍：财报PDF表只给上市具体日期而没有消费者体验；记录尊重该有限范围。validation的自动闭合通过与“ID待协调/未导入”并存，正文不得把内部校验包装成正式采纳。第三遍已全长连续。

逐句审读[0,3500)：Quest正文把免接PC的便利紧接环境感知、供电和场地限制，语气避免将“独立”说成没有条件。型号句限定第一代并排除后代功能，时间句区分预定发货与可购确认。
逐句审读[3500,7000)：Quest 3段落以茶几/虚拟钢琴这一厂商举例作任务入口，后文将其明确限定为原厂场景；“相机显示而非透明镜片”是关键必要否定，避免读者误以为裸眼透视。型号与容量边界再次保持清晰。
逐句审读[7000,10500)：事实栏把日本销售确认与版本识别分别对应来源ID，关联章节只作策展阅读。PSVR2叙述限定2023 PS5首发，明确不将后来的PC适配器倒填，保持时间语境。
逐句审读[10500,14000)：PSVR2的否定句具体保留旧PS VR游戏不直兼容、PS4不适配及透视非录影等边界；收束明确不把后续PC适配/更新写成首发承诺。Vision Pro段落随即转到M2/R1首代限定。
逐句审读[14000,17500)：Vision Pro设计/使用段具体说明视线、捏合、语音与外置电池；“EyeSight不是透明玻璃”防止直觉误读，保留有用的否定解释。文字将厂商展示场景与普遍效率主张分开。
逐句审读[17500,21000)：Galaxy XR条目用地图/视频交互说明服务入口，并明确该示例为原厂展示。几处否定分别防止将Moohan原型当商品、英国扩展当新代、二维照片处理误作原生立体拍摄；这些限定是历史型号准确性所必需。

passes.focus: 逐句文风候选及历史保留理由（含必要否定）
passes.notes: 第三遍留意措辞：VX1000段以“对于想拍摄并在之后整理视频的人”落到具体任务，避免宏大科技史判断；“没有取消磁带”“不会消除运动或声音问题”是重要否定边界，建议保留。 第二段语气把机械媒体与数字信号并置；“数字信号并不等于没有机械媒体”是可保留的简洁反误读句。Sony设计意图不应扩展成所有使用者舒适度结论。 PowerShot 600 文本强调“数字保存与机身显示可以分开设计”，措辞有辨识力；保留日本版/600N边界与不将其写成现代全功能起点的必要否定。 第三遍对 PowerShot 600 的否定留意为风格特征：不将选配件设为默认，不补现代接口，文件存档和实机状态另核；这是谨慎且具体的历史边界。 COOLPIX 300 的风格观察：以“照片负责…文字或笔迹负责…”这种并列句形成易记表达；保留短备注优于长文的实用限制。 XL1段的“配置范围扩大，同时操作成本也扩大”是凝练的策展句；选配件、机身重量、兼容、声音与磁带作为代价一并出现，不能删到只剩灵活性赞语。 COOLPIX 900 行文通过低位拍摄的具体情境解释镜头/显示部分旋转；“变焦决定画面范围，旋转决定方向”是清晰区分两种控制的候选句。 D1 行文将连续拍摄速度加上“有条件”限定，建议保留；“按完快门”与“完成保存”的间隔将技术限制转成读者能理解的操作时间。 D1 段保留“未实测旧卡兼容”“历史说明不等于当前可用性保证”的克制结尾；从规格转实操再回到边界，结构完整。 5D II以“SET而不是照相快门”和“不能用后代自动追焦推断原流程”两句守住操作准确度；可保留作为这份展品的读者可执行信息。 展品叙述在5D II处以可复述的动作顺序收尾；随后来源字段中，标明厂商支持文档未实拍、历史页面无独立性，属于整体文字谨慎语气的基础。 可读风格延伸到来源表：逐项写verificationMethod与limits，体现不把截断/无法解析/索引摘录包装成全文核验；建议保留这种透明度。 核对品牌历史、外部采集流程、来源时间范围：文字避免混用首发固件/后代功能，整体保留“原厂资料不是独立用户评价”的限定句。 历史来源收尾明确厂商受托文章不计独立媒体评测，馆藏对象制造年不得替换上市年，文字开放许可也不涵盖照片；这些否定保留能避免把证据等级和复用权利写过头。

passes.notes: 第三遍观察：G1以“取景链路”解释无反，避免将名词分类当解释；“省去一种机械结构不等于整套器材没有体积”是平衡便携叙述的重要否定句，建议保留。 第二段对G1的风格：比较光学/电子取景各自承担的工作，避免只用“新架构”宣传词；必要否定包括不争“全球第一”、不将镜头系统误解为无体积。 E-P1第三遍关注：日期写11月已售公告而非六月计划；“PEN复古记忆不等于纯机械相机”为关键反误读句，可保留。 X100这段把固定镜头的得失写成具体站位和距离问题，而非空泛“局限”；“混合结构不是同时拥有所有方案的全部优点”准确提醒没有万能方案。 X100限制段的节奏把视差、电子延迟、代际、生产/上市、当前支持分别列清；“旧机状态需另行核查”保留历史与实物判断的分界。 Phantom表述把“用户任务”和飞行控制条件分开，语气不夸大自动能力；“改变的是相机位置”对照全景后期改变观看方向，是简洁而准确的比较。 GR III风格重心是承认普通好用也值得记录，不强造行业革命；评测没完整复读/利益未确认的说明应保留，避免“独立媒体”被误读为利益全无。 X5叙述先说为何需要360再解释剪辑、再指出拼接和数据处理代价；“不是完全不用构图”是精确保留用户现场责任的必要否定。 TZ300文风坦承日常好用就有入选价值，不需冒称技术首创；长焦方便与手持、主体运动和电池限制同段呈现。 这段涉及来源记录和逐展项媒介意见：授权/验证字段以明确范围呈现，媒体评价不混作馆方实测，复用限制继续单列。 Fuji原手册记录初代X100适用范围，DJI晚期手册日期2014且不用于回填首发能力；G1厂商上市回顾不证明独立体验。三类证据性质在源字段中区分。 关于 E-P1，原公告与售卖公告用于不同节点；“计划日期不等于实售”在正文和来源中交叉出现，反复提示不是赘余，而是日期精度保护。 来源正文保留原始验证不足字段，即便补充 verificationRecords 加强细节，也不抹去此前索引阅读范围，体现历史记录的可追踪性。 X5评测的短期样机使用和佣金声明有助于解释证据力度；不把作者意见扩展到长期耐用，也不把商品链接利益关系省去。 TZ300原厂公告和Phantom同日来源分别体现厂商证据边界；后者不作为独立媒体、图片转载许可或用户效果研究。末尾导入说明是待审文字，不执行。
